en: Color postcard showing a fortified Moldavian church with a steep red roof and blind-arcade facade set on stone terraces and a wooden walkway; people stroll in a landscaped park below. The reverse has a Romanian 40 BANI 'POSTA ROMANA' stamp with București postmark, printed caption identifying the church in several languages, and handwritten address and short message.
